title: Juice N Power Creamy Tobacco Power 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Creamy Tobacco from Juice N Power is a treat for tobacco fans owing to its rich, robust and authentic Tobacco flavour. Those irresistible earthy, woody, smoky notes are enhanced with a layer of thick, dense cream providing an extra indulgent, almost cigar-like experience. Shortfill bottles from Juice N Power E-liquids offer the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in shortfills. Juice N Power are a UK e-liquid producer with a passion for creating bold, delicious flavours across nic salts, shortfills and 50/50 juices. Their juices surprise and delight with unique flavour pairings that use only the best ingredients for a quality vape every time.
